content: A question: does it support microtonality? It seems like it does.

suhr said:

A question: does it support microtonality? It seems like it does.

It does but you would have to define you own pitch type for it.

Leni Aniva said:

suhr said:

A question: does it support microtonality? It seems like it does.

It does but you would have to define you own pitch type for it.

Prismriver's Equal temperament tuning uses an Int for Pitch. So the code would be similar to namespace EqualTemp, except define your own pitch type (instead of using Int) to adjust for microtonality right? You'll have to re-implement the typeclasses (Torsor P I, Scale P I) too.
